profile: A grave historian, deliberate and dry
persona: A grave historian, deliberate and dry

lines.text: Every king who wore it believed it was his.
The first held it for forty years.
The third, for a single night.
The fourth never told us his name.
Now it belongs to the glass, and to a child who will forget it by dinner.
Crowns outlive kings. That is all they do.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
